long_biography.plain_text:
Athens College has been the centre of Annika Papantoniou's public work for more than three decades. Beginning with its parent associations in 1989, she moved through successive leadership roles before becoming chair of the Hellenic-American Educational Foundation. Her tenure has emphasized the institution's scholarship programme, alumni support and centenary fundraising.

Papantoniou's business background comes from A.M. Nomikos, the maritime group established by her parents in 1958. An economics and business administration graduate, she became a vice-president as the founders' three children assumed responsibility for the family enterprise. Her charitable work also includes serving as treasurer of the George and Marie Vergottis Charitable Foundation.
